taittiriya_chapter1_verse4.title: Taittiriya Chapter 1 Verse 4
taittiriya_chapter1_verse4.introduction: This verse belongs to Taittiriya, Chapter 1.
taittiriya_chapter1_verse4.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Taittiriya Upanishad, Chapter 1, Verse 4, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
taittiriya_chapter1_verse4.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
